title: useCopyToClipboard Hook
description:
Implement a `useCopyToClipboard` hook that returns `{ copy, copied }`. Calling `copy(text)` writes `text` to the clipboard. `copied` is `true` for 2000 ms after a successful copy, then resets to `false`.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { copy, copied } = useCopyToClipboard();
<button onClick={() => copy(code)}>{copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}</button>
```
ai_context: Learners often start a new timeout on every copy without clearing the old one, so rapidly clicking copy can cause the copied state to reset unexpectedly early.
